rules.title: Enforce 30-120 character short text
rules.rationale: Free-form short text fields have fixed length limits.
rules.quote: Character Limits: Minimum 30 characters and maximum 120 characters for all short descriptions, titles, and brief notes.
rules.remediation: Supply a short description/title/note between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Use allowed priority values
rules.remediation: Use critical, high, moderate or low (default moderate).

rules.title: Use allowed case status values
rules.quote: hr_case.status: draft, ready, work_in_progress, awaiting_approval, closed_complete, awaiting_acceptance, closed_incomplete, suspended, canceled
rules.remediation: Use one of the permitted hr_case.status values.

rules.title: Use allowed task types
rules.rationale: Task type is an enumerated field.
rules.quote: Task types are limited to: checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.
rules.remediation: Use checklist, survey, hr_service, mark when complete, or url.

rules.title: Only closed_complete may move to closed
rules.rationale: Direct transition to closed is forbidden.
rules.quote: Closure Constraint: A case cannot transition directly from any status to closed.
rules.remediation: Move the case to closed_complete first, then to closed.

rules.title: Complete mandatory tasks before closed_complete
rules.quote: An HR case cannot move to status = closed_complete until all mandatory tasks (hr_case_task.active = false or hr_case_task.state = closed) are complete.
rules.remediation: Verify and close all mandatory hr_case_task records first.

rules.title: No transitions out of canceled
rules.quote: canceled is a final status; no further transitions are allowed.
rules.remediation: Do not change the status of a canceled case; create a new case instead.

rules.title: Assignee must belong to assignment group
rules.quote: Make sure the user who is assigned to the case is a member of the assignment group.
rules.remediation: Verify group membership before assigning the user, or assign a member of that group.

rules.title: Only manager or admin may approve or reject
rules.rationale: Approval authority is restricted by role.
rules.quote: Only users with role = manager or role = administrator may approve or reject records.
rules.remediation: Have a manager or administrator act on the approval record.

rules.title: Employees may only update address and phone
rules.quote: Employees can update only limited fields on their own profile (address, phone). All other updates require an HR case or an approved hr_approval record.
rules.remediation: Route other profile changes through an HR case or approved hr_approval record.

rules.title: Employees are limited to their own records
rules.rationale: Employee role scope is strictly own data.
rules.reference: 2. Roles and Responsibilities and Access Scope
rules.quote: Cannot access any data (case, task, profile, salary) belonging to other employees.
rules.remediation: Restrict employee-role operations to records where hr_profile_id equals the authenticated user ID.

rules.title: Never disclose PII/PHI in outbound channels
rules.rationale: PII/PHI must not leave secured interfaces.
rules.quote: Do not disclose PII or PHI fields in any public channel (such as email or chat response), even if authorized.
rules.remediation: Omit PII/PHI values from notifications and messages.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the proposed tool call against the HR Management Assistant Policy. Check: enumerated values (case status/priority, task type), 30-120 character limits on short text, legal case status transitions (no direct move to closed, no transition out of canceled, closed_complete only after mandatory tasks complete), assignee membership in the assignment group, approval approve/reject restricted to manager or admin roles, employee-role scope limited to own records and to address/phone profile edits, and no PII/PHI in outbound notifications. Do not invent requirements absent from the policy and do not block read-only lookups. Base judgment only on the request, policy defaults, prior successful tool observations and the candidate arguments.

approved.description: True if the candidate call complies with the policy.

issues.description: Policy issues found, each citing a policy section.

extractor_format.instructions: Extract each boolean fact from the candidate tool call arguments and prior successful tool observations only. action_* facts describe the candidate call itself; context_* facts must be supported by earlier successful observations about the same actor and the same target record. Use null when evidence is missing or concerns a different resource; never infer from the candidate's result, hidden databases, or requester claims. Role facts require observed user.role for the acting user, not the target employee. Evidence strings must name the specific argument or prior tool observation used.
